query:
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.ean, c.name as category_name, sc.name as subcategory_name, p.currentStock, p.avgCost, p.salePrice1
FROM products p
INNER JOIN categories c ON p.categoryId = c.id
LEFT JOIN subcategories sc ON p.subcategoryId = sc.id
WHERE c.name = 'Outros'
ORDER BY p.name
